barriers.planningHint: Frontend draft: register the all-in-one recognition unit with camera type and board, then test the connection. Control commands differ by board. A lane can bind only an online unit. Connection tests are simulated; backend comes later.
barriers.createHint: Enter the unit name, code, camera type, board, and address. The board determines open/close commands. Connect it first, then bind it on a lane.
barriers.name: Recognition unit name
barriers.codeLocked: Recognition unit code cannot be changed after creation

boardHints.ZS_IO: Controls the barrier with camera IO pulses. Open, close, stay open, and lock use different IO pins.
boardHints.ZS_RS485: Sends hex frames over RS485. Open, close, and status query use different frames.
boardHints.HX_RELAY: Controls the barrier with relay pulses. Open and close use different relays.
boardHints.QY_IO: Controls the barrier with camera GPIO pulses and can query gate status.
boardHints.GENERIC_RELAY: Generic relay open/close for camera boards not listed above.

barriers.emptyHint: Ask an administrator to register a recognition unit.
barriers.emptyHintAdmin: Click Add recognition unit to register an all-in-one with camera and board, then run docking tests.
barriers.formRequired: Enter recognition unit name, code, and device address
barriers.codeTooShort: Recognition unit code must be at least 2 characters
barriers.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, code, address, camera, or board
barriers.debugHint: Test the connection first. After the device is online, send the command set for this board. Lane binding is also available only then.
barriers.needConnected: Test the connection and wait until the device is online.
barriers.panelHint: Only online ANPR all-in-ones can be bound. Register and test devices on ANPR all-in-one docking.

endpoints.title: Server Endpoint Configuration
endpoints.pushDesc: Configure this address in the camera admin under Advanced Network → HTTP Push. The camera pushes recognition results automatically.
endpoints.pollDesc: Configure this address in the camera admin. The device periodically polls for open/close gate commands.

iot.planningHint: Frontend draft: register a DTU or serial server by IoT device model, then test the connection. The device sends open/close commands over RS485. A lane can bind only an online device. Connection tests are simulated; backend comes later.
iot.createHint: Enter the device name, code, model, access mode, and address. The protocol determines RS485 commands. Connect it first, then bind it on a lane.
iot.name: Device name
iot.codeLocked: Device code cannot be changed after creation
iot.deviceSnHint: Required for USR Cloud or SN-based DTUs. Leave blank for local TCP.
iot.deviceSnRequired: USR Cloud access requires a device serial number
iot.slaveIdHint: Modbus slave ID. Transparent mode also uses it in the RS485 frame.
iot.slaveIdInvalid: Slave ID must be an integer from 1 to 247

modelHints.USR_TCP232_304: Single-port TCP serial server for one barrier RS485 link.
modelHints.USR_N540: Four-port serial server. One unit can drive multiple barriers.
modelHints.USR_G771: 4G DTU via USR Cloud or public network, for sites without LAN.
modelHints.USR_DR302: DIN-rail serial server. Defaults to Modbus RTU control.
modelHints.USR_W610: Wi-Fi serial server. The device waits as a TCP server.
modelHints.GENERIC_DTU: Generic serial server / DTU using transparent or Modbus frames.

registerModeHints.LOCAL_SERVICE: This service opens a port. The DTU connects as a TCP client.
registerModeHints.DEVICE_SERVER: This service connects out to the device TCP server.
registerModeHints.USR_CLOUD: Reach the device by serial number via USR Cloud. SN is required.

protocolHints.TRANSPARENT: Forwards hex frames to RS485. Fits most barrier controllers.
protocolHints.MODBUS_RTU: Writes Modbus registers to open or close the barrier.

recognitionRecords.planningHint: Frontend draft: recognition records are stored locally. Successful lane simulations write Device-type rows; the backend API comes later.
recognitionRecords.emptyHint: Simulate entry/exit on a lane; when the pass conditions are met, a record is written here.
recognitionRecords.addHint: Manually backfill an entrance or exit recognition record. The record is marked as manual.

parkingSessions.planningHint: Frontend draft: entry recognition opens a parking session; exit matches the nearest prior unmatched open session for the same lot and plate.
parkingSessions.voidHint: Review the entry and exit details below. This action cannot be undone.
parkingSessions.voidConfirm: Void this parking session? Linked entry/exit recognition records will also be voided.
parkingSessions.emptyHint: Successful entry simulations create a session; exit simulations close the best matching open session.

accessJudgment.title: Access judgment configuration
accessJudgment.hint: Configure the evaluation order for blacklist, whitelist, and pattern allowlist rules per parking lot.
accessJudgment.orderHint: Drag items to reorder. Rules are checked from top to bottom; the first match wins.

accessJudgment.readOnlyHint: Only administrators can change this configuration.
